dz: 阿尔内穆伊登战役(法语:Battle of Arnemuiden)是法军击败了英军,是百年战争中第一次海战,也是第一次使用火药火炮的欧洲海战.
de: The Battle of Arnemuiden, in which a French force defeats the English, is the first naval battle of the Hundred Years' War and the first European naval battle in which gunpowder artillery is used.
